content.title: Actual source merge, native ref13 return and selected-cycle obstruction checked
content.text:
Checked code b5af50adbe71b5d23480e4226ffb523c22a67730 is pushed on formalize and independently verified. Main remains e53852064d3ef5a2eafec47d754c27504b11de5f.

Actual CURRENT accepted source and the SAME root build now derive complete stored universe rows, cached body depth zero, heap preparation and finite-fuel completion of the actual source-grouped merge. The merge extends that heap, introduces no Mu records, retains input atoms and bounds ordinary prefix height. No supplied universe or callback result enters these source laws.

The actual native ref(U)/Mu(U) request completes at 13 and all larger fuels with the SAME complete final machine, valid caches, complete coverage, retained source records and no free native references. Exact equality with the original U remains OPEN; a closed native value is not a finite accepted term witness.

The SAME accepted initializer now connects to exact whole identity-eager-worker metadata erasure at every fuel, retaining ordered outputs, duplicates, failures and cache/caller/query endpoints. Fixed configuration: identity narrowing, empty templates, no stop callback or slot preference; arbitrary fixed edge traversal. Haskell enumerateFully really uses noExpansionPreference; spaceOrder controls edge weighting, so it must not be confused with slot selection. Older configured OuterNarrow wrappers are not identity entry points.

Three actual-clear laws are checked: an already represented closed suspended-reference cycle survives selected true-clear; proper paths rule out a common finite assignment; consequently that actual clear cannot make such an existing proper cycle satisfiable. Mixed fragment/path dependencies and full reachable-history coverage remain OPEN.

All new public modules pass builds, strict checks, independent imports and full Audit: 95,836 aggregate imported theorems; separately 60 explicit reports, 58 standard-axiom and two axiom-free. Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound occur. These counts do not establish the complete goal.

The full finite original-root witness with ONE assignment remains OPEN, including parked recompletion and implementation correspondence. Next: same-writer depth/ordinary probe packets, mapped row normalization and actual probe replay to select the original Mu key. Two prerequisite candidates are UNCOMPILED; the exact identity header is UNPROVED. No Haskell/Cabal/test change or new Haskell defect/fix was established.
